say:1:1033118001:1.text: He was attacked by them. Luckily, the injuries aren't too serious, as I barely have enough herbs to staunch the wound.
say:1:1033118001:1.source_cn: 被咕布林袭击了，还好伤势不重，我手上这点止血药勉强够用。
say:1:1033118001:1.male: He was attacked by them. Luckily, the injuries aren't too serious, as I barely have enough herbs to staunch the wound.
say:1:1033118001:1.female: He was attacked by them. Luckily, the injuries aren't too serious, as I barely have enough herbs to staunch the wound.

say:2:1033118002:1.text: If anyone else gets hurt, we won't have anything for them.
say:2:1033118002:1.source_cn: 万一再有人受伤，我们就没的用了。
say:2:1033118002:1.male: If anyone else gets hurt, we won't have anything for them.
say:2:1033118002:1.female: If anyone else gets hurt, we won't have anything for them.

say:3:1033118003:1.text: But we really need painkillers right now. Otherwise he'll just attract more gruglins here, and then we'd all be in trouble!
say:3:1033118003:1.source_cn: 不过现在最要紧的是止疼药，不然他迟早会把咕布林引过来！...
say:3:1033118003:1.male: But we really need painkillers right now. Otherwise he'll just attract more gruglins here, and then we'd all be in trouble!
say:3:1033118003:1.female: But we really need painkillers right now. Otherwise he'll just attract more gruglins here, and then we'd all be in trouble!
